# `dashboard/routes/profile.ts`

Module providing profile-related route utilities for the dashboard. Currently exposes credential-fetching logic for authenticated users.

---

## Functions

### `getUserCredentials`

Retrieves all stored credentials associated with a given user.

> **Note:** This function is not directly exported from the module's public surface. Use the path import shown below to access it.

```ts
import { getUserCredentials } from '..'
```

#### Signature

```ts
async function getUserCredentials(userId: number): Promise<{
  id: number;
  createdAt: Date | null;
  userId: number;
  provider: string;
  vaultSecretId: string;
  label: string | null;
}[]>
```

#### Parameters

| Name | Type | Description |
|------|------|-------------|
| `userId` | `number` | The unique identifier of the user whose credentials are to be fetched. |

#### Returns

`Promise<{ id: number; createdAt: Date | null; userId: number; provider: string; vaultSecretId: string; label: string | null; }[]>`

Resolves with an array of credential records. Each record contains the following fields:

| Field | Type | Description |
|-------|------|-------------|
| `id` | `number` | Unique identifier of the credential record. |
| `createdAt` | `Date \| null` | Timestamp when the credential was created, or `null` if unavailable. |
| `userId` | `number` | The ID of the user this credential belongs to. |
| `provider` | `string` | The name of the authentication or service provider. |
| `vaultSecretId` | `string` | Reference identifier for the secret stored in the vault. |
| `label` | `string \| null` | Optional human-readable label for the credential, or `null` if not set. |

#### Example

```ts
import { getUserCredentials } from '..'

const credentials = await getUserCredentials(42)

for (const cred of credentials) {
  console.log(`Provider: ${cred.provider}, Label: ${cred.label ?? 'N/A'}`)
}
```
